jobs.title: Software Engineering - Lead Data Scientist
jobs.jd: FICO (NYSE: FICO ) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential! The Opportunity The my FICO (Scores B2C) engineering team is seeking a Lead Data Scientist to build and run machine learning and Generative AI solutions in our consumer applications. This lead-level software engineering role builds the data pipelines that prepare large datasets for modeling, develops ML models and puts them into production with monitoring and retraining, and measures business impact through experimentation. You will also set ML engineering best practices for the team. What You’ll Contribute Build and maintain Python data pipelines that ingest, clean, and transform large datasets into reliable, analysis-ready data and ML features. Profile and validate data, and put quality checks in place so models and analyses can be trusted. Develop machine learning models, such as propensity, churn, segmentation, and forecasting, from problem framing through evaluation. Deploy models to production in AWS for batch and real-time scoring, monitor performance and drift, and automate retraining. Design, evaluate, and improve LLM prompts, and integrate Generative AI capabilities into existing applications. Design and analyze A/B tests to measure business impact, and explain results to product and marketing partners. Lead design discussions and code reviews, mentor engineers and analysts, and set ML engineering best practices. Partner with database engineering, product management, and InfoSec to build secure, compliant solutions that handle sensitive consumer data responsibly. Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows, such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, to accelerate delivery while reviewing and refining their output. What We’re Seeking Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience in data science, machine learning engineering, or applied AI, including models running in production. Strong Python for data engineering and ML (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PySpark), with comfort working in Jupyter notebooks. Proven experience building data pipelines and processing large datasets with Spark, Redshift, or similar technologies, plus expert SQL skills for complex queries on large datasets. Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. Experience operationalizing ML models, including deployment, monitoring, retraining, and CI/CD (SageMaker, MLflow, Docker, or similar), and running data and ML workloads in AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda, Bedrock, or similar). Experience with LLMs (Claude, OpenAI GPT, or similar), including prompt design, evaluation, and deploying Generative AI solutions in production. Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design, and hypothesis testing. Production ownership, including code review, release management, and mentoring, with the ability to explain technical results to non-technical partners. Experience with RAG workflows, vector stores, MCP server integrations, LLM fine-tuning, workflow orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions), or regulated consumer data such as credit and financial services is a plus. Our Offer to You An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others. The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences. Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so. An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie. The targeted base pay range for this role is: $105,000 to $165,000 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience. Why Make a Move to FICO ? At FICO , you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more. FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide: • Credit Scoring — FICO ® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders. • Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems. • Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score. Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO ’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks! jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist
jobs.jd: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: As a Senior Data Scientist at Hims & Hers, you are a core driver of technical execution and innovation within our data organization. You take complex business challenges and translate them into robust, scalable data products and machine learning models. You will be trusted to operate with high autonomy, owning your projects from the initial exploratory analysis through to production deployment. In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to deliver solutions that optimize our operations, refine our marketing efforts, and enhance the customer experience. You will not only build powerful models but also help uphold the engineering rigor and standards of our data team. You Will: Build from Scratch: Thrive in a 0-to-1 environment. You are comfortable rolling up your sleeves to write complex SQL, engineer your own features, and deploy baseline models (heuristics or simple ML) quickly to prove value before iterating toward complex solutions. End-to-End Execution: Own the complete model lifecycle, from data extraction and feature engineering to deployment, A/B testing, and ongoing performance monitoring. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Finance teams to define technical requirements and translate model outputs into clear, actionable business insights. Uphold Technical Standards: Write clean, modular, and production-ready code. Actively participate in peer code reviews and contribute to the team’s technical best practices. Drive Project Delivery: Navigate technical ambiguity within your domain, breaking down complex project requirements into manageable, executable milestones. Team Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and support to junior data scientists and analysts, helping them troubleshoot roadblocks and adopt best practices. Experience & Skills: 5+ years of applied experience in Data Science or ML Engineering, with a track record of delivering production-ready models that drive measurable business value. Technical Proficiency: Strong expertise in Python and SQL. Deep familiarity with the Python data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and standard ML frameworks (such as PyTorch, XGBoost, or LightGBM). Engineering Rigor: Proven ability to build for production. Experience working in cloud-based environments (AWS or GCP) and familiarity with CI/CD workflows, version control (Git), and ML Ops principles. Analytical Problem Solving: Strong ability to connect technical metrics to business outcomes. You know how to choose the right algorithm for the right problem rather than just the most complex one. Communication: Excellent ability to explain technical concepts, model limitations, and analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders. Education: BS, MS, or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, CS, Applied Math, etc.). Preferred Qualifications: 0-to-1 Execution: Experience taking the very first machine learning models in an organization from exploratory notebooks to reliable, automated production pipelines. Advanced Business ML (Experience in 1-2 of the following): Customer Behavior & Propensity Modeling: Building predictive models for churn, propensity-to-buy, lead scoring, or lifetime value (LTV) to directly drive targeted marketing and product interventions. Applied Forecasting: Time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, or handling non-stationary data for demand or revenue planning. Optimization: Building engines for marketing spend, inventory management, or resource allocation. Causal Inference: Designing robust experiments (e.g., quasi-experiments, difference-in-differences) to measure true business impact beyond standard A/B testing. We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Places
jobs.jd: In a world where many social apps measure their success by time spent online, Places offers a different kind of product built by Raya , a technology company focused on providing utility. Our apps, Raya and Places, are tools for discovery of and access to exciting people and places globally. We believe that by marrying great software with a membership-based community built around core values of trust, curation, and authenticity, we can provide solutions that offer something different to infinite content and AI-slop. Places’ mission is to help discerning global travelers find their favorite places wherever they go through expert curation and community trust. As a Data Scientist on the Places by Raya team you will play a key role that will shape how the Places app uses data to drive business decisions. This hands-on role combines data modeling and reporting with product analysis and experimentation. While the product itself has existed since 2023 the culture is very much like a new start-up with leadership being heavily invested in this product space and this role being the first dedicated Data Scientist to this space and supported by a dedicated Data Engineer. We are seeking an entrepreneurial and driven data scientist to identify opportunities to improve retention and help the team evaluate and act on them. This will be a fun role for someone who wants to build data solutions from the ground up and help shape how the entire team uses insights. This person should be able to articulate best practices, develop new analytical frameworks that tie user actions to outcomes, and strike the right balance between analytical rigor and pragmatic business action. Successful candidates will demonstrate technical skills, product expertise, and business acumen, and be enthusiastic about making a positive impact through timely execution. You are passionate about leveraging the power of data to drive product changes with quality and agility and can demonstrate sound judgment under uncertainty. Responsibilities Own the definition and evolution of success metrics for all user facing surfaces, including tradeoffs between short-term and long-term member value. Define and maintain business metrics, semantic layers, and data models to ensure consistency and trust across the Places team. Own, in partnership with Data Engineering, the translation of product requirements into scalable, reliable data assets that empower efficient decision-making Influence product direction by uncovering and translating insights into clear recommendations that shape roadmap prioritization. Build out a culture of high fidelity experimentation to scale wins quickly Using visualisations to convey nuance with clarity AI-native mindset and hands-on experience using LLMs, agents, and modern AI tools to automate analysis, accelerate experimentation, and build scalable decision-support workflows Qualifications 5+ years of data science and product analytics experience BS and/or MS in a quantitative discipline: statistics, operations research, computer science, engineering, applied mathematics, physics, economics, etc. Familiarity in delivering data products through partnership with Data and product engineering teams. Strong technical fluency with analytical tools such as SQL and Python, or equivalent experience using data to answer open-ended business questions. Strong applied statistics background, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, power analysis, and causal inference techniques. Familiarity with modern analytics and experimentation tools Familiarity with consumer focused . Strong in proactive verbal and written communication, ability to convey rigorous statistical concepts to non-experts. Practical AI fluency and curiosity about how modern AI tools can improve analytical workflows, strategic synthesis, and decision support. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Personalization
jobs.jd: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify ’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. Growlithe is a fast-moving squad within Spotify's Conversation Product Area, focused on bringing emerging Search and agentic experiences to life. We explore, define, build, validate, and optimize new ideas to help listeners discover the content they love. Our work spans personalized Search, music video discovery and ranking, audiobook Search expansion, and the foundations of more social Search experiences. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help shape the next generation of Search at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of machine learning, personalization, and product development, turning complex challenges into intuitive discovery experiences for millions of listeners. What You'll Do Build and improve machine learning models that make Spotify Search more relevant, personalized, and engaging for listeners. Develop and optimize ranking and backend retrieval systems that help listeners discover music, videos, audiobooks, and other content. Explore emerging AI and agentic approaches to create more intuitive and conversational Search experiences. Design, implement, and evaluate machine learning solutions, taking ideas from early experimentation through production. Partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and researchers to identify opportunities and deliver meaningful improvements to Search. Use experimentation, data analysis, and performance metrics to understand model behavior, validate hypotheses, and improve the listener experience. Contribute to scalable machine learning infrastructure and engineering practices that support reliable, high-quality Search experiences. Share knowledge, challenge assumptions constructively, and help shape the technical direction of machine learning within the squad. Who You Are You have experience building, deploying, and improving machine learning systems in production environments. You have a strong understanding of machine learning approaches for information retrieval, search ranking, recommendation systems, or personalization. You are proficient in Python and comfortable working with modern machine learning frameworks and data processing tools. You have experience and a desire to lean into backend engineering at Spotify scale. You understand how to design and evaluate experiments, interpret model performance, and translate technical findings into product improvements. You have experience working with large-scale datasets and understand the challenges of building reliable, scalable machine learning systems. You are curious about emerging AI technologies, including large language models and agentic systems, and interested in their potential to improve discovery experiences. You enjoy working across disciplines, communicating technical ideas clearly, and learning from different perspectives. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of complex challenges, and balancing experimentation with practical delivery. Where You'll Be This role is based in Eastern Standard Time We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Compensation Additional Information The United States base range for this position is 184,049–262,928 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.title: Working Student - LLM Inference Performance
jobs.jd: About Tensordyne AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! About the Role How fast should an LLM building block run on our hardware? How fast does it actually run, and what would make it faster? As a Working Student, LLM Inference Performance, you'll help answer these questions by working directly with our hardware and software engineering teams. You'll write and optimize low-level kernels, benchmark performance on real silicon, and develop profiling tools that help engineers understand and improve LLM inference performance. You'll gain hands-on experience with our Rust programming stack and Python SDK, use AI coding agents as part of your development workflow, and collaborate closely with engineers working on compilers, runtimes, and kernel optimization. This is an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world AI hardware challenges while taking ownership of meaningful technical projects. What You'll Do Understand our hardware: Learn how Tensordyne silicon processes data, manages memory, and synchronizes operations, and how key LLM components such as attention, MLP, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing map onto the architecture.. Develop and optimize kernels: Implement, test, and tune low-level kernels to improve the performance of LLM inference workloads.. Analyze performance: Build analytical and roofline performance models, compare predictions against simulator and real-silicon measurements, and investigate performance bottlenecks.. Build benchmarking and profiling tools: Develop benchmark harnesses, profiling scripts, and trace visualizations that make performance easier to measure, understand, and improve.. Work with AI coding agents: Explore workflows where AI agents assist with kernel development, optimization, and benchmarking, and identify the tools and context they need to work effectively.. Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with compiler, runtime, and kernel engineers to translate performance insights into practical improvements.. Example project: Develop a benchmarking and profiling harness for an LLM building block, such as decode attention, at two abstraction levels. Compare measured performance against theoretical estimates and make the tooling accessible to AI coding agents. What We're Looking For Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.. Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of C, C++, or Rust.. Understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, bandwidth, and parallel computing through academic coursework or personal projects.. Interest in low-level programming, hardware performance, and optimization.. Practical experience using AI coding agents in development workflows, with the ability to evaluate and improve their output.. An experimental mindset, with the ability to form hypotheses, analyze measurements, and communicate technical findings clearly.. Curiosity, initiative, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies.. Nice to Have Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus: GPU or AI accelerator programming.. Embedded systems or bare-metal programming.. Performance profiling, benchmarking, or optimization.. LLM inference fundamentals and architectures.. Why Join Tensordyne? Work on cutting-edge AI technology: Contribute to the development of next-generation AI inference hardware and software.. Gain hands-on experience: Apply your university knowledge to real silicon and challenging engineering problems.. Own meaningful projects: Build tools and solutions that directly support our engineering teams.. Learn from experienced engineers: Work alongside specialists in hardware architecture, compilers, runtimes, and performance optimization.. Explore AI-assisted development: Gain practical experience building with AI coding agents and shaping how they interact with advanced hardware systems.. Make a lasting impact: Help develop performance tools and workflows that will support both current and future generations of Tensordyne technology.. Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed. Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone. Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals. Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do. Own it and get it done. Results matter! Make each person better together than they would be as an individual. Embrace each other's differences, and embrace that there will be differences. Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Recommendations
jobs.jd:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

What does the team work on?

Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico with 70+ million active accounts. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The depth of query, content, and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness on the search and discovery journey, and this team owns the models that power it across the Roku platform.

What is the role?

The depth of query, content and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness in their search journey. Solving this customer problem is why we’re actively looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Recommendations to drive further innovation in search and discovery. The person in this role will leverage their technical skills, business intuition, and analytical thinking to build best-of-class AI-powered products. Communication and presentation skills are important. The role requires both high technical acumen and problem-solving abilities, motivation, and exceptional attention to detail. Every day, you’ll look at what exists and find ways to make it better.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Apply state of the art ML on search using techniques in deep learning, bandits, transformers, LLMs, causal inference, and optimisations to make our users more delighted and engaged on the platform
  • Run online AB tests and analyse them against the critical business KPIs
  • Collaborate with US engineering teams as well as cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Nurture our ML ecosystem to make it withstand scale, developer velocity and future business shifts
  • Provide technical leadership to drive technical and ML roadmap for search ranking and monetisation
  • Help in recruiting new engineers. Interview, train, and mentor new team members

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • 8+ years of experience (or PhD with 6 years of experience) applying Machine Learning to concrete problems at large-scale in domains like recommendation or search or ads
  • Strong CS fundamentals. Should be able to convert ideas to code with ease
  • Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals like classification, deep neural nets, and sequence-based models. Familiarity with modern NLP stack and multi-modal representation learning is a plus
  • We’d love to see that you’ve worked with big data systems (Spark, S3, and Airflow) and can program (Java, Scala, or Python)
  • Good understanding of system architecture. Have experience in big data technologies and streaming architecture, data pipelines, etc.
  • Demonstrated AI/agentic-tooling fluency per the section above
  • MS in Computer Science, Statistics, or related field, but a Ph.D. in CS or related fields is preferred

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

 

What are some of the benefits?

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (AI, ML, Pyspark, SQL)
jobs.jd: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior Data Scientist (AI, ML, Pyspark, SQL) Overview The Business & Market Insights (B&MI) team within Mastercard's Services division creates products that help customers including financial institutions and merchants understand their customers and the market better. The B&MI Data Science team uses data from Mastercard transactions and other sources to build models and solutions that are needed for these products, at a globally scalable level across the different customer lifecycle stages. This role is for a Data Scientist that will work across Product, Client Services & Delivery, Data & Engineering and the broader teams, to deliver truly differentiated products driven by analytics & AI, leveraging rich data resources, AI platform capabilities and near real-time execution. We are developing multiple new products and capabilities using analytics & AI, and this role is central in that vision, from concept, technical design to market release and optimization. This role is positioned to drive new ideas forward by combining creative thought leadership with innovation and industry best practices. By entering in the early phase of a truly transformative and impactful strategic initiative, the experience is certain to be rewarding. This role requires the successful candidate to have the following: - 5-9 years of overall career experience in Data Science function supporting Products - Design, develop, and productionize machine learning and data science solutions that solve complex business problems within BMI. - Develop traditional ML solutions covering feature engineering, model training, validation, evaluation, and deployment. - Perform exploratory data analysis and translate complex datasets into actionable insights. - Optimize data pipelines and ML workflows for performance, scalability, maintainability, and reliability. - Develop robust and reusable Python components following sound software-engineering practices. - Use PySpark to process, transform, and analyze large datasets efficiently in distributed environments. - Write advanced, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, feature development, and analytical workloads. - Apply appropriate controls for data privacy, security, responsible AI, monitoring, and explainability. Good to have: - Understanding of building Generative AI applications using Python and modern GenAI frameworks. The successful candidate’s primary responsibilities will be to: - Drive the evolution of Business & Market Insights products by applying Data Science and Artificial Intelligence to create models, tools and capabilities - Participate in the exploration, application and development of data science for product development - Participate in identification and evaluation of AI/ML techniques and tools to deliver models and analytics for product development - Continuously innovate and determine new data science approaches & technologies to solve business problems and generate business insights & recommendations - Partner with roles across the organization including product, engineering, and sales to determine the highest priority data science problems to solve in a customer-centric framework - Evaluate trade-offs between many possible analytics solutions to a problem, taking into account performance, usability, technical feasibility, timelines, and differing stakeholder opinions to make a decision - Break large solutions into smaller, releasable milestones to collect data and feedback from product managers, clients and other stakeholders - Evangelize releases to users, incorporating feedback, and tracking usage to inform future development - Work with small, cross-functional teams to define vision, establish team culture and processes - Consistently focus on key drivers of organization value and prioritize operational activities accordingly - Identify and act upon product improvement opportunities - Provide technical leadership of junior colleagues as a senior member of the data science team, through technical and non-technical mentoring Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The successful candidate’s primary responsibilities will be to: - Drive the evolution of Business & Market Insights products by applying Data Science and Artificial Intelligence to create models, tools and capabilities - Participate in the exploration, application and development of data science for product development - Participate in identification and evaluation of AI/ML techniques and tools to deliver models and analytics for product development - Continuously innovate and determine new data science approaches & technologies to solve business problems and generate business insights & recommendations - Partner with roles across the organization including product, engineering, and sales to determine the highest priority data science problems to solve in a customer-centric framework - Evaluate trade-offs between many possible analytics solutions to a problem, taking into account performance, usability, technical feasibility, timelines, and differing stakeholder opinions to make a decision - Break large solutions into smaller, releasable milestones to collect data and feedback from product managers, clients and other stakeholders - Evangelize releases to users, incorporating feedback, and tracking usage to inform future development - Work with small, cross-functional teams to define vision, establish team culture and processes - Consistently focus on key drivers of organization value and prioritize operational activities accordingly - Identify and act upon product improvement opportunities - Provide technical leadership of junior colleagues as a senior member of the data science team, through technical and non-technical mentoring Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Expert Data Scientist, Fraud Risk Detection
jobs.jd: Overview Experian's Fraud Analytics & Commercialization operates across four main functions. These include client engagement analytics, scalable and custom analytics for financial institutions, fraud analytics consulting, and solution integrity and enablement for production-ready platforms. We're looking for a motivated Data Scientist to help build fraud detection models and features that identify high-risk activity while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Core skills for this role include an eagerness to collaborate, and empathy. You will will dig into surprising signals in the data and to learn how that insight becomes a deployed model. You will help investigate the latest fraud patterns, build features, and train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with senior data scientists and engineers starting with problem definition through feature engineering, experimentation, and deployment. You will be a developing programmer, ready to translate theoretical principles into production-ready solutions. We continue to sharpen through research and the engineering that turns those findings into tools and systems built for commercialization. This is a remote role and you will report into the Sr. Manager of Fraud Analytics. What you'll do Investigate large datasets, including exploratory analysis and fraud label development, to identify latest fraud patterns, attack methods, and behavioral signals. Translate ambiguous fraud and risk problems into clear hypotheses, analytical plans, model requirements, and measurable success criteria. Develop machine learning models for fraud detection across account opening, account takeover, and identity risk. Evaluate models using metrics like ROC/AUC/KS/Gini, precision/recall, fraud capture rate, false-positive rate, customer friction, and fraud losses prevented. Develop and validate predictive features using identity, transactional, consumer credit history, device, behavioral, temporal, velocity, network, and third-party data. Write clean, efficient, well-tested Python and PySpark code, and collaborate with teams to bring models and features into batch, retro, or real-time decisioning environments. Monitor feature quality, model performance, population changes, and fraud-pattern drift Design and present analyses for model behavior, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations Follow appropriate standards for data privacy, model documentation, explainability, validation, and governance. Qualifications At least 5 years of experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a related quantitative field Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, statistics, engineering, data science, or another quantitative discipline Direct experience developing fraud-detection, identity-risk, credit-risk, financial-crime, or other adversarial risk models. Demonstrated experience creating meaningful fraud features Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with experience writing modular and tested code for large datasets and distributed or cloud data systems. Experience using common data science and machine-learning tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or comparable technologies. Knowledge of supervised learning, model evaluation, feature selection, statistical inference, experimentation, and model calibration. Experience navigating challenges common to fraud modeling, including class imbalance, delayed or incomplete labels, changing attack patterns, and model drift. Experience moving models beyond experimentation and into production, either directly or in close partnership with engineering teams. #LI-Remote Benefits/Perks: Great compensation package and bonus plan Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays Explore all our exciting benefits here: https://yourexperianbenefits.com/cand-index.html Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose-driven culture is multi award-winning. We have won World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @ experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of a recruitment process. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors such as job-related skills, experience, and education. You will be eligible for a variable pay opportunity and a comprehensive benefits package. Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.jd: We are looking for a Data Scientist who thrives on creating value, not just building models. This role sits within the Asia Intelligence team, a pragmatic, product-minded group focused on shipping data and AI solutions that make an impact today. You will work closely with engineers, analysts, and stakeholders across Ubisoft to design, build, and evolve AI-powered products that are already in production and growing in ambition. Success in this role is defined by your ability to deliver alongside your team. We care about shipped outcomes, not just experimentation. If you are energised by moving quickly, doing your work end-to-end, and seeing real players affected by what you build then this is the role for you. WHAT YOU WILL DO Your core responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain machine learning models and AI products that are deployed in production and create measurable value for players and the business Contribute to personalisation and decisioning systems - including recommendation engines, segmentation models, propensity scoring, and Next Best Action frameworks - that directly influence player retention and engagement Support the development of AI agent architectures and automation workflows that extend the team’s capacity to deliver intelligence at scale Translate complex stakeholder needs into well-scoped, pragmatic solutions, balancing model sophistication with delivery speed and operational sustainability Collaborate closely with data analysts, data engineers, and product stakeholders to ensure models are integrated, understood, and acted upon In six months: You will have developed a strong working knowledge of our data infrastructure, player behaviour data, and live operations context across active titles You will have familiarised yourself with our suite of ML models spanning forecasting, propensity modelling, and player decisioning, and made meaningful contributions to at least one You will have expanded our AI/ML programme to cover additional player engagement scenarios and franchises, including personalisation and player decisioning capabilities You will have built trusted working relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their needs and how data science can serve them In twelve months: You will be a core contributor to the evolution of our personalisation and player engagement capabilities, including our Next Best Action engine and propensity modelling programme You will have helped shape the roadmap for new AI product opportunities, drawing on a clear view of where ML and agent-based approaches can generate near-term value for the business Essential: At least 3 years’ experience in an applied Data Science or ML role, with a track record of shipping models or AI products into production Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable outcomes through applied ML: your work has made it into the hands of end users, not just into a notebook Strong collaborative instincts: you understand that impact comes from working well with others, not from working alone Pragmatic problem-solver who can scope work appropriately, move fast where needed, and know when good enough beats perfect Comfortable working across disciplines, from game designers and producers to analysts and engineers, with strong communication skills to match Desired: Hands-on experience building personalisation engines, recommendation systems, or player decisioning frameworks Work experience with marketing decisioning platforms such as Adobe Marketing Cloud, Salesforce, Pega, Braze, or similar Experience designing or contributing to AI agent architectures and agentic workflows An interest in games, entertainment, or consumer-facing digital products where player or user behaviour is central to the work TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS Essential: Strong Python skills, including experience writing production-grade code beyond notebook prototypes Solid SQL skills for data exploration, feature engineering, and pipeline work Hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as scikit-learn, LightGBM, PyTorch, or Spark ML Expert-level proficiency in Databricks and/or Snowflake, with experience deploying and managing models in a cloud data platform environment Version control proficiency (git) and familiarity with collaborative development workflows Desired: Experience with MLflow, Delta Lake, or similar tools for model tracking and data management in Databricks environments Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex or Databricks Genie for AI-assisted analytics Experience building or integrating LLM-based agents or tool-use frameworks Familiarity with API development and the deployment of model-serving endpoints We are working to enrich players’ lives through unique and memorable gaming experiences and by improving the positive impacts of our games. To get there, we are creating a safer, more inclusive work environment, we are giving back to the communities where Ubisoft operates by working with local non-profit partners and by working to reduce the environmental impact of our business. We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or disability status. Come on board and experience #LifeAtUbi for yourself, we are always on the lookout for talents who thrive in bringing their A-game to work. If this sounds like you, shoot us your resume, portfolio, and anything else to show that you’re serious about fun!

jobs.title: Data Scientist - H/F/NB
jobs.jd: En nous rejoignant sur ce poste, vous intégrerez une équipe multidisciplinaire (data, programmation, game & narrative design, animation, etc.), guidée par une question simple et ambitieuse : parmi toutes les possibilités offertes par l’IA générative, lesquelles sont réellement intéressantes et fun pour le gameplay ? L’équipe a pour mission de tester de nouvelles expériences auprès de joueurs et joueuses, et d’équiper les créateur·rices pour imaginer des interactions plus dynamiques, immersives et surprenantes — jusqu’à faire émerger des features impossibles à réaliser autrement. Son quotidien s’inscrit à la croisée de la R&D, du développement produit, de la création de jeux courts et de la collaboration multi-studios, au service des gameplays de demain. Dans le cadre de ce poste, vous rejoindrez une équipe développant un produit technologique favorisant l'intégration de l’IA au sein des fonctionnalités de nos jeux. Au sein de nos studios de production, vous pourrez apporter vos connaissances en Data Science afin de construire des expériences de jeux uniques. Missions Au sein de l’équipe du produit technologique intégrant l’IA générative dans nos gameplays, vous apportez vos connaissances en Data Science et Machine Learning afin de prototyper et modéliser des solutions permettant la création de nouvelles expériences de jeu: Identifier des objectifs en fonction des spécifications partagées par les équipes de design et à travers l’analyse des données joueurs et définir des protocoles d’évaluation Concevoir des prototypes et entrainer des modèles pour répondre à ces objectifs Collaborer avec les Machine Learning Engineers pour transférer les prototypes et définir les critères de succès en vue de leur intégration. Collaborer avec les designers pour analyser les comportements de vos IA et identifier des pistes d’améliorations du jeu. Identifier les opportunités d’expérimentation et d’innovation. Communiquer sur vos travaux et vos résultats de façon pédagogique pour un public varié. Vous disposez au moins d’une première expérience significative en tant que Data Scientist, durant laquelle vous avez pu mener des projets sur des produits interactifs (jeux, apps, systèmes temps réel …), Vous avez une bonne maitrise de Python ainsi que Tensorflow ou PyTorch (avoir une expérience en pyspark est un +), Vous disposez de solides bases en statistiques et méthodes d’évaluation (analyse exploratoire, tests statistiques, A/B testing), Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse de données complexes et séquentielles issues de systèmes interactifs et avez de bonnes connaissances des LLM , Vous êtes une personne dotée d’une bonne capacité d’écoute, de compréhension et vous savez traduire les besoins des clients en spécifications , Vous faites preuve d’autonomie et de curiosité et avez un véritable intérêt pour le jeu vidéo. Enfin, votre maîtrise de l’anglais vous permet d’être à l’aise dans les échanges écrits et oraux avec des interlocuteurs de différents pays. En tant qu’employeur, Ubisoft offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi, sans distinction notamment de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ubisoft veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité de sa communauté de joueurs dans ses équipes.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Remote
jobs.jd: Worum es geht MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen. Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen. Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig. Was du bei uns machst Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen. Deine Schwerpunkte: Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren. Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran. Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen. Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases. Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt. Was wir suchen Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype. Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat. Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein. Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle. Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen. Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren. Remote führen. Du führst auch aus der Ferne wirksam. Du kommunizierst proaktiv, machst Entscheidungen schriftlich nachvollziehbar und bist für das Team gut erreichbar. Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich. Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch. Arbeiten bei MAIA Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung. Ein großer Teil des Teams arbeitet gemeinsam in unserem Büro in Leipzig, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kocht fast jeden Tag zusammen. Du arbeitest remote von überall in Deutschland, dein Wohnsitz muss in Deutschland liegen. Zweimal im Jahr treffen wir uns zu Team-Events, und ab und zu gibt es Teamtage in Leipzig. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest. Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu Führungsthemen Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft Vergütung Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem Interview zu Technik und Führung. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP. Bewerbung und nächste Schritte Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten? Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff. Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges Interview zu Technik und Führung und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. jobs.title: (Senior) AI Engineer (m/f/d) – Remote
jobs.jd: What we do MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation. On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets. Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021. What you'll do As an AI Engineer, you develop MAIA further and help decide from the start how we solve problems. What you can work on: From concept to feature. Together with product management, you sharpen rough concepts and own features from prototype to continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data. Chat and agents. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context and letting agents complete multi-step tasks, with traceable progress and verifiable results. Unlocking company knowledge. You connect external systems and make knowledge from many different file formats usable. This way, MAIA finds the right passages, delivers answers with sources and respects existing access rights. Models and quality. You integrate new language models and compare quality, cost and speed. With evals, you detect errors and systematically improve answers and agents. Secure, fast and stable. You build isolated environments for running code and tools and improve response times and data processing, so that MAIA runs reliably even with large knowledge bases. What we're looking for Solid software engineering. You have built and shipped backend systems and operated them in production over a longer period. Architecture, API design, data modelling and asynchronous processing are familiar to you. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it. Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others. At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built real applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects. You know RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling from practice, including where they fail. You try out new models and frameworks on your own initiative and separate substance from hype. Production experience with LLM systems is a big plus. Measure, don't guess. You know how to test and evaluate systems that don't always give the same answer to the same question. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem. Additional retrieval stages, prompt chains or abstractions only come in when measurements justify them. Product thinking. You think about the person who needs to finish a quote under time pressure or clarify a technical question with MAIA. You like to get involved early in product management's concepts, ask the right questions and contribute your own ideas, even when not everything is settled yet. Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't. Security-minded. Our customers trust us with their internal knowledge. Tenant isolation, access rights and secure development are second nature to you. Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination. Clear communication. You explain technical topics clearly, including to product management, customer success and sales. You are fluent in English. German is a plus. This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest. Working at MAIA We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development. Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you. Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents Support for training that fits your professional development Access to a Wellpass membership Compensation The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP. Application and next steps You don't need a cover letter. Send us your CV and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA? We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine. If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks. We look forward to your application. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist — Data Cloud Acceleration
jobs.jd:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

About the team 

The Data Cloud Acceleration team identifies gaps and opportunities across clients and business units, then moves quickly to deliver practical new capabilities. We often develop and deploy the first version of a model, workflow, dataset, or application in days or weeks, learn from real usage, and improve it iteratively. 

We are business-minded technologists who care more about impact than technical novelty. We use sophisticated methods when the problem requires them and simpler approaches when they will deliver a better result faster. Our work should be predictable, demoable, trusted, reusable, measured, and amplified by AI. 

 

About the role 

The Senior Data Scientist will build models, analyses, and supporting ML components that improve business decisions, intelligence products, and client outcomes. You will independently own defined deliverables—from understanding the requirement and preparing the data through modeling, validation, documentation, and delivery. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will work across varied revenue and intelligence initiatives, often in partnership with a Lead Data Scientist, application engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. The right candidate can move quickly without sacrificing trustworthiness and knows how to balance statistical rigor with the practical needs of the business. 

 

What you’ll do

  • Own model and analysis deliverables. Take a defined business problem and independently deliver a reliable model, analysis component, scoring workflow, or supporting dataset.  

  • Translate business questions into analytical approaches. Ask clarifying questions, understand how the output will be used, and recommend an approach that fits the decision, timeline, and available data.  

  • Build and test models quickly. Develop practical solutions using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, or existing models and services where appropriate.  

  • Prepare trustworthy data. Profile, cleanse, join, and validate noisy datasets while checking completeness, freshness, distributions, nulls, duplicates, and match rates.  

  • Create repeatable scoring workflows. Move useful work beyond the notebook by building reusable Python components, batch-scoring processes, APIs, or lightweight services.  

  • Evaluate results responsibly. Establish baselines, select appropriate metrics, perform statistical reasonableness checks, reconcile unexpected results, and clearly document limitations.  

  • Support intelligence products and applications. Work with application and data teams to define the right data ingredients, test hypotheses, and integrate model outputs into usable experiences.  

  • Add operational discipline. Include validation, monitoring, failure handling, refresh expectations, documentation, and a clear usage path in delivered work.  

  • Use AI to improve your own productivity. Apply tools such as Claude, Codex, and similar assistants to accelerate coding, testing, research, debugging, and documentation while independently verifying the results.  

  • Communicate progress early and clearly. Make milestones, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and issues visible rather than waiting until delivery.  

 

What ownership looks like at this level

You are expected to own the deliverable. That means: 

  • Working independently on a well-defined model, workflow, dataset, or component  

  • Producing reliable and repeatable outputs rather than one-time analyses  

  • Adding appropriate validation and basic monitoring  

  • Documenting assumptions, methodology, limitations, and usage  

  • Demonstrating the output and explaining how it supports the business  

  • Raising risks and ambiguity early

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform
jobs.jd: We are looking for a product-minded AI engineer to turn what our customers are trying to decide into agents they actually rely on. AskWaive, our in-product assistant, is already live; the work now is quality, coverage, and an experience that wows. This is not a role for a prompt author or a demo builder. We want an owner: someone who takes a customer need—already expressed through our serving layers and semantic layer—and turns it into an endpoint, a tool, and an experience that makes the customer measurably better at their job. Agent engineering, deployment, and testing are all part of delivery, not a handoff. Our core data platform is owned by the team that built it. You'll build on top of it—and where data or infrastructure is holding an agent back, you'll have the standing to propose the change and drive it. What You'll Do From Customer Need to Product Superpower Own the Outcome: Start from the customer, and stay with it until the agent is answering their needs better Build Agents and Tools: Build production agents and the tools they call—retrieval, multi-step workflows, action-taking—on Amazon Bedrock, with Bedrock AgentCore as our runtime and tools exposed over MCP (Model Context Protocol). Turn Serving Layers Into Capability: Our semantic layer and service APIs are where customer needs are already expressed. Your job is turning them into endpoints and tools an agent can wield well—and knowing which metrics and entities it should reach at all. Shape the Experience, Not Just the Endpoint: How an answer arrives—its speed, its confidence, its explanation, the next step it offers—is the product. A technically correct response a customer ignores is a failure. Prove It and Make It Felt Measure Groundedness: Build the eval harness—labeled test sets, groundedness and hallucination rates you can put a number on, and CI gates that stop a regression before it ships. Measure What Customers Got: Adoption, feedback, intent—then report realized impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up. Diagnose and Iterate: Instrument the tracing that shows why an answer was wrong, turn each failure mode into a specific fix, and ship again. This loop is the job, not a phase of it. Deliver Ship and Operate: Own the serving path—MCP endpoints, latency, cost per response, caching, and runtime guardrails. Deployment and testing are part of the job, not a handoff. Embed and Influence: Partner with Product Managers and engineers on which decisions an agent should support—and which it shouldn't. Where data or infrastructure limits what an agent can do, drive the change alongside the team that owns the platform. Who You Are The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions with the agent's help, not by whether it shipped. The Agent Builder: You've taken an agent past the demo. You know the hard part is everything after it works once—coverage, grounding, cost, and the failure modes you only see at scale. You fix problems without waiting for a ticket. The Experience Obsessive: You care how an answer lands, not just whether it was right. Trustworthy, fast, and legible beats clever. We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you are a builder who cares about the "why" behind the code, we want to hear from you! HOW WE WORK We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next task faster for the whole team. The leverage is in the verification: the tests, CI gates, and typed interfaces that make agent-written code safe to merge. What You"ll Bring Experience: 5+ years building production software or data-intensive systems used by real customers, with strong Python skills—including at least one LLM or agent feature you shipped to production users. AWS & Agent Stack: Hands-on AWS experience, ideally Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore. Equivalent agent runtimes transfer, but we build on AWS and you'll be productive faster if you have prior exposure. Agent Engineering: Orchestration, tool and function design, context assembly, and multi-step workflows—you've made the design calls, not just the prompt calls. Retrieval & Domain Grounding: You've built retrieval over real business data, you can explain how context gets selected and why an answer was wrong, and you have enough SQL and metric fluency to catch an agent answering with the wrong number. Evaluation & Iteration: You've built or owned an eval loop for a generative system—labelled sets, regression gates, and a number you could defend when someone asked whether it got better. Product Sense for AI: You have opinions about how an agent should behave—when to answer, when to ask, when to refuse, how to show its work—and you've shipped those opinions, not just argued them. Measurement & Narrative: You've quantified what an agent actually delivered for users—adoption, task success, decision quality—and presented it to people who were never going to read your traces. Working With Agents: You've used coding agents on real production work, you can tell correct output from merely plausible output, and you invest in the harnesses that make the next task faster. Communication & Collaboratio n: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working across technical and non-technical teams. Bonus Points For: LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, LangSmith, or Arize). Semantic layer or metrics-layer design (Ossie, dbt). Field-service, logistics, or other operational SaaS domains. Prior experience as a senior or lead engineer responsible for guiding technical direction. Location: Remote (UK-based) with occasional collaborative team meetups.
